lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The time came for the LORD to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind. Elijah and Elisha travelled together from Gilgal.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the Jordan, Elijah struck the water with his cloak. The river divided, and they crossed on dry ground.

lines.speaker: elijah
lines.text: Tell me what I can do for you before I am taken from you.

lines.speaker: elisha
lines.text: Please let me inherit a double portion of your spirit.

lines.speaker: elijah
lines.text: You have asked for something difficult. Yet if you see me when I am taken from you, it will be granted.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared. They separated Elijah and Elisha, and Elijah was carried up into heaven in a whirlwind.

lines.speaker: elisha
lines.text: My father! My father! The chariots and horsemen of Israel!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Elisha picked up Elijah's cloak. The prophetic mission did not end—it passed to the next generation.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The story of Elijah ends with a prophet taken from the earth, but God's work continues through Elisha.
